meta.purpose: Demo/prototype seed data: configurable scheme rules for 4 real Ministry of Tribal Affairs (MoTA) schemes for ST students
caveats: Post Matric regulations are 'applicable from 01-04-2022'. NFST / Top Class / NOS guidelines in hand cover 2021-22 to 2025-26. Check tribal.gov.in for any 2026-27 revision before claiming 'current' in front of judges.
NFST fellowship rates are pegged to UGC rates and may have been revised after 1 April 2022.
NOS benefit amounts (living allowance, contingency, airfare caps) were NOT in the documents read; left as null on purpose.
Top Class institute list: 265 institutes (revised list, 2023-24 onwards). Older documents say 252/158; use 265.
sources: MoTA Guidelines, National Fellowship & Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students 2021-22 to 2025-26: https://iitj.ac.in/PageImages/Gallery/03-2025/National-Scholarship-for-Higher-Education-of-ST-students-638766146772781079.pdf
Lok Sabha reply with income ceilings (ST): https://eparlib.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/711424/1/9499.pdf

shared_rules.income_definition: Gross income from all sources, no exemptions or deductions under Income Tax Act
shared_rules.false_statement_penalty: Award cancelled, amount recovered, blacklisted from all schemes
shared_rules.payment: DBT to Aadhaar-seeded bank account in the student's own name, mobile number linked
cross_document_checks: Applicant name identical across ST certificate, income certificate, marksheet, bank passbook, Aadhaar
Date of birth identical across Aadhaar, 10th certificate, application form
Income certificate financial year = FY preceding the selection/admission year (salaried: Form-16 of previous FY acceptable)
Income certificate must come from a competent authority (e.g. Tehsildar/DM/Executive Magistrate); self-declaration or affidavit NOT accepted (PMS); monthly income certificate not accepted (NOS)
ST community name must match the notified ST list of the state (NOS: spelling must match latest Gazette notification)
CGPA marksheets must come with the institute's CGPA-to-percentage conversion

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship for ST Students
schemes.type: Centrally Sponsored Scheme (GoI 75% / State 25%; NE & hilly states 90/10)
schemes.implementing_body: State/UT Government of the student's domicile state
schemes.portal: State scholarship portal or National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)

eligibility.category: Scheduled Tribe of the domicile State/UT
eligibility.must_have_passed: Matriculation / Higher Secondary or higher exam from recognised board/university
eligibility.bank: Valid scheduled-bank account linked with Aadhaar and mobile
exclusions: Studying in a Top Class institute covered by the National Scholarship (Top Class) scheme (dedupe rule)
Completed one stream and now taking a different stream (e.g. B.Com after B.A.)
institution_types: UGC 2(f)/12(B) universities and colleges, deemed universities
Private universities with NAAC/NBA 'A' level or equivalent
Private professional institutions affiliated to recognised university
Recognised diploma institutes, NCVT-affiliated vocational institutes

benefit.fee_rule: Fixed by State Level Fee Fixation Committee. GoI support ceiling in private institutes per year: Engineering 250000; MBBS/MS/MD 600000; other courses 100000
benefit.disability_note: Also applies to leprosy-cured and sickle cell anaemia/thalassemia students

documents.name: Last qualified marks (% or CGPA equivalent)
ST certificate from competent authority of State/UT
Family income certificate (once, at admission; valid for whole course)
Aadhaar-linked bank account details (student's name, IFSC)

workflow: Student registers and applies online
Level 1: Institute Nodal Officer verifies against physical documents (verify / reject / mark defective, with reason)
Level 2/3: District/State Nodal Officer verifies (verify / defective / reject)
State sanctions and disburses via DBT
Ministry monitors via DBT portal (dbttribal.gov.in)
renewal: Renewed year to year if previous class passed and promoted
Failed students get nothing until they clear the class and are promoted
Fresh income certificate NOT required at renewal
Good conduct and regular attendance required
Cancelled if student changes course/institute without State approval, or on false statements
ocr_deficiency_flags: Income certificate missing / over ceiling / wrong FY / affidavit instead of certificate
ST certificate community not in domicile state's ST list
Bank account holder name does not match applicant
Marksheet shows CGPA with no conversion formula
Institute AISHE/U-DISE code missing or institute not empanelled
Applicant's institute is in the Top Class list (route to Top Class scheme instead)

schemes.name: National Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students (Top Class)
schemes.type: Central Sector Scheme (100% central funding), sub-scheme of 'National Fellowship & Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students'
schemes.level: Graduate and Post Graduate in notified premier institutes (IITs, NITs, IIMs, AIIMS, NLUs, NIFT, etc.)

eligibility.admission: Merit admission to a notified institute and notified course (list of 265 institutes)
exclusions: Anyone claiming any other Central/State scholarship for the same study
eligibility.slots: No institute-wise, state-wise or stream-wise ceiling

benefit.tuition_and_admission_fee: Full for government institutes; ceiling 250000 per year in private institutes
benefit.note: Books and computer paid without bills/vouchers. Tuition goes to institute via PFMS, or reimbursed to student on receipt. Rest paid by DBT, once a year.

documents.name: Income certificate for FY preceding selection year (Form-16 for salaried)
Bank passbook scan (name must match application)
Qualifying marksheet: 12th (UG) or graduation (PG); renewal: last passed semester

workflow: Student registers on NSP and applies after taking admission
Institute Nodal Officer verifies uploaded documents against physical copies and confirms genuineness of certificates (no verification fee)
Ministry verifies; discrepancies marked 'defective' and visible to student
Student corrects, institute re-verifies, Ministry final verification
Selection list published on MoTA website; Ministry decision final
Payment via PFMS; institute submits Utilisation Certificate (GFR-12A)
schemes.renewal: Continues to end of course subject to satisfactory performance certified by institute; income certificate taken once at admission
ocr_deficiency_flags: Institute not in the 265 notified list, or course not notified
Admission under management quota
Income above 6,00,000 or certificate for wrong FY
Bank passbook name mismatch
Fee receipt missing or not matching bonafide

schemes.name: National Fellowship for Higher Education of ST Students (NFST)
schemes.portal: https://fellowship.tribal.gov.in (usually opens ~1 July, closes ~30 September); Aadhaar + DigiLocker registration mandatory

eligibility.mode: Regular, full-time M.Phil/Ph.D in UGC 2(f)/12(B) institutions, UGC-grant deemed universities, grant-receiving institutions, Institutes of National Importance
exclusions: Any other fellowship/scholarship for the same study

slots.unfilled_rule: Vacant slots cascade to the next category; remaining applicants ranked on PG marks
slots.priority_note: Applicants with admission offers from IITs/AIIMS/IIMs/IISERs get priority

benefit.rates_note: Equal to UGC rates; verify against latest UGC revision
benefit.hra: 8% / 16% / 24% by city class (UGC rates); not payable if university hostel provided
benefit.tenure: M.Phil 2 years; Ph.D or M.Phil+Ph.D 5 years max
benefit.payment: Quarterly via PFMS; last quarter released only after thesis uploaded to repository.tribal.gov.in

documents.name: Post-graduation marksheet (aggregate %; CGPA conversion formula if applicable)
Admission/joining certificate for M.Phil/Ph.D from university

workflow: Scholar registers on fellowship portal (Aadhaar + DigiLocker)
University Nodal Officer verifies physical documents against portal upload
Ministry verifies; defective applications returned to student, corrected, re-verified by university
Merit list on PG marks within category slots; Ministry Selection Committee (Secretary MoTA chair, JS&FA, JS Scholarship, MoSJE and UGC representatives)
Provisional award; scholar must join and submit joining report within 1 month
Post-selection: refund of any other fellowship, NOC, quarterly continuation certificates (10 Jul, 10 Oct, 10 Jan, 10 Apr), annual progress report
ocr_deficiency_flags: PG aggregate below 55% or CGPA without conversion
Age above 36 on 1 July (computed from 10th certificate DOB)
ST/PVTG certificate missing or illegible
No admission/joining certificate for M.Phil/Ph.D
Disability claimed but certificate below 40% or missing
Part-time / non-regular course

schemes.name: National Overseas Scholarship for ST Students
schemes.level: Master's, Ph.D, Post-doctoral abroad (top 1000 QS World Ranking institutions)

eligibility.income_note: Parents'/family income from all sources. Certificate must be annual (monthly not accepted). If father alive but income not reported, a declaration giving the reason is required

min_marks_pct_by_level.PostDoc: 55% in Master's with Ph.D completion certificate

eligibility.marks_waiver: 55% criterion does not apply to candidates already admitted in a top-1000 QS institution
eligibility.one_child_rule: Only one child of the same parents; one-time assistance
exclusions: Cannot hold State and Central scholarship together

slots.female_note: Unfilled female slots may go to male candidates

benefit.tuition_and_visa: Reimbursed through Indian Mission after joining; no advance payments
benefit.airfare: Ministry arranges air ticket on request; return ticket only if course extended
benefit.extension_rule: Extension beyond course duration only on university recommendation, without financial assistance
benefit.amounts_note: Not in documents reviewed; fill from official NOS guidelines before the demo

documents.name: DOB proof: 10th/Matriculation certificate or Birth Certificate only
ST certificate (community spelling must match latest Gazette)
Masters: graduation marksheet; PhD: PG marksheet; PostDoc: PG marksheet + Ph.D award
Student ID and visa copy in one PDF
Offer letters merged into one PDF, highest-ranked university first

schemes.file_format_rules: All documents PDF; photo JPG/JPEG 50-100 KB
workflow: Register on overseas portal, fill form (save draft allowed; no edits after final submit; registration details never editable)
Selection (merit, personal interview for those without offer)
Provisional award letter issued after results
Confirmation letter only after: antecedent form, health certificate, passport, visa, caste/income verification report from State, and joining proof
Joining deadline: 2 years from provisional award, else cancelled; course change not allowed after provisional award
ocr_deficiency_flags: Age over limit for chosen level (32/35/38)
Marks under 55% and not already admitted to top-1000 QS university
Monthly income certificate uploaded instead of annual
DOB proof is not 10th certificate or birth certificate
Community name spelling differs from Gazette
Photo outside 50-100 KB or not JPEG; documents not PDF
CGPA marksheet without conversion formula
Income above 6,00,000

ai_assist_ideas_human_decides: OCR extract -> auto-fill form fields -> highlight mismatches against typed values
Rule engine reads each scheme's JSON (income ceiling, age cut-off, marks, doc list) and produces a deficiency list with reasons
Cross-scheme router: given course + institute, recommend PMS vs Top Class vs NFST vs NOS and block double-claiming
Official sees AI findings with confidence + source snippet; only the official can verify / mark defective / reject / select
Plain-language deficiency notices in Hindi/regional language for the applicant
